throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: ldptr.d $r12, $r20, 0; ldptr.d $r13, $r20, 8; ldptr.d $r14, $r20, 16; ldptr.d $r15, $r20, 24; ldptr.d $r16, $r20, 32; ldptr.d $r17, $r20, 40; ldptr.d $r18, $r20, 48; ldptr.d $r19, $r20, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024' --asm 'ldptr.d $r12, $r20, 0; ldptr.d $r13, $r20, 8; ldptr.d $r14, $r20, 16; ldptr.d $r15, $r20, 24; ldptr.d $r16, $r20, 32; ldptr.d $r17, $r20, 40; ldptr.d $r18, $r20, 48; ldptr.d $r19, $r20, 56'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: Throughput measured with a 1KB stack buffer. Latency not measured; memory latency depends on cache state.
